justification: GST-3260 PR 3 (R51 final full review after a granted fix-check; decision 3.5 hunks include files the fix created): deterministic no-loss replay preregistered in docs/evals/r51-final-review-after-grant-prereg.md, no paid run, passing in test/r51-final-review-replay.test.ts. Plan replay against main's lib/review-depth.ts (blob 47ac26b): all 2,596 recorded test histories and all 1,658,880 grid histories without the new grantFixChecked field plan the same step and reason as main; with the field (1,105,920 grid histories) the planner never plans a fix-check or scoped pass and adds a full review only where main said done after a granted fix-check whose range changed runtime lines (27,648); on ten real shapes (#4537, harness-evals#508, #4612, #4597, harness-evals#504, #4664, #4663, gbrain#10036 and two controls) every old step still runs, in order, and the only added step is one read-only full review after the granted fix-check, followed only by done or stop. Packet replay: with no untracked file the documented hunks command is byte-identical to plain git diff $PASS_HEAD (tracked edits, a committed fix plus an edit, a committed new file, a deletion, ignored files); a created file is included. ship/sections/review-army.md also gains decision 3.5's replan after a granted fix-check, non-reviewer /ship prose; every brief body lib/review-brief.ts cuts keeps its pinned hash (test/fixtures/review-pins/brief-bodies unchanged). Reviewer prompt text is unchanged. After a spent grant whose fix range could not be read (uncommitted or untracked edits), the plan stops and asks for the fix to be committed instead of reading the range as docs only; that adds a stop, never a fix round or a skipped review. Decision 3.5 also says a post-grant NEXT: stop is never convergence: an unreadable fix range commits the fix and asks again, any other stop is decision 2; that removes a path that could skip the final review and changes no reviewer text.
